content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to show data from two [product_name] modules on one [product_name] web interface? I have 10 motors and want to display each motor's temperature, but since each module supports only 8 analog inputs, I need to use two units. Thanks.

This is possible, but not in a straightforward way. The web server can only access its own [product_name] module directly. To show data from other modules on the same web server, you have to transfer the data via a connection to the VM memory of the first module. Then the web server will be able to read the data.
Great, thank you for your assistance!

analysis.insight_summary: Users want to display temperature readings from multiple [product_name] devices in a single web interface. However, the [product_name] web tool only supports direct visualization from one device at a time, making it necessary to manually transfer data between modules to combine the results, which increases the complexity of the process.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a simple solution for displaying temperature data from several [product_name] devices in one web interface, without needing complicated manual data transfers.
